smallest_next_calculation.question: Can equilibrium-consistent boundary changes move geodesic/compression and bad-curvature/compression independently enough to test them?
smallest_next_calculation.validity_tag_if_run: plausibly-local until equilibrium checks pass; then equilibrium-consistent intervention candidate
smallest_next_calculation.why_information_gain_is_high: It tests whether the proposed causal intervention exists before any GX expenditure; failure immediately removes or replaces an arm.
